resume_bullets: Built and measured a preliminary single-node Triton/RTX 4080 testbed for four named seeded CUDA test models using governed HIGGS/Criteo inputs across 22 physical runs; fixed-window balanced concurrent throughput was n=3 median 799.90 req/s [799.37, 800.00] (+67.6% vs serial median); batch-on throughput was n=3 median 443.83 req/s [439.80, 444.00] (-44.5% vs batch-off) and formed mean batch size median 2.04 [2.03, 2.05]; and the 70% offered hot-model mix observed n=3 median normalized-attainment Jain fairness 1.000 [1.000, 1.000]; service errors/loss=0, local admission rejections=261328. The Criteo DLRM-lite path used deterministic seeded test parameters and makes no training-quality or model-accuracy claim.
